summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to study the suitability and feasibility of adding Saratoga and Washington Counties in New York to the Maurice D. Hinchey Hudson River Valley National Heritage Area.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a suitability/feasibility study for expanding a National Heritage Area. This requires minor federal administrative effort and associated costs, representing a very small expansion of government activity and spending.
